pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is a role of trees and plants? (1 mark)
   A. They make the sun set
   B. They give oxygen and shade
   C. They stop rain forever
   D. They dry up rivers

2. Which element is called Vayu? (1 mark)
   A. Earth
   B. Air
   C. Space
   D. Fire

3. Which sacred river of India did the lesson say is honoured as a goddess in the stories? (1 mark)
   A. Beas
   B. Rijubalika
   C. Nzoia
   D. Ganga

4. Where do Hindu families often grow Tulsi? (1 mark)
   A. Only in a river
   B. In a pot or raised stand in the courtyard
   C. Under the roof
   D. In the kitchen fire

5. What should you do when you join a religious activity of another faith? (1 mark)
   A. Refuse to sit
   B. Laugh at it
   C. Listen carefully and behave politely
   D. Make noise

6. What did Siddhartha later become? (1 mark)
   A. A Sikh Guru
   B. The Buddha, the Awakened One
   C. An Avtar of Vishnu
   D. A Jain Tirthankar

7. At what time of day did Narsimha appear in the story? (1 mark)
   A. At sunrise
   B. In the evening, between day and night
   C. At midnight
   D. At noon

8. What does the word Guru mean? (1 mark)
   A. A soldier
   B. A teacher who leads from darkness to light
   C. A river
   D. A festival

9. From where did Narsimha appear in the story? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A pillar in the palace
   C. The sky at noon
   D. A boat

10. What did Siddhartha do for the wounded swan? (1 mark)
   A. He ignored it
   B. He took it away to eat
   C. He pulled out the arrow and nursed it
   D. He shot it again

11. What was the name of Siddhartha's father? (1 mark)
   A. King Dasharatha
   B. Hiranyakashipu
   C. King Suddhodana
   D. Guru Amar Das

12. What is the Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. A book of maps
   B. A book of wise sayings and verses
   C. A long story of a king
   D. A list of temples

13. Who was Sigala? (1 mark)
   A. A Sikh Guru
   B. A Jain monk
   C. A young man taught by the Buddha
   D. A king of Ayodhya

14. What does Ik Onkar stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Many rivers
   B. Six directions
   C. There is one God
   D. Two gods

15. Which is a mistake about scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Making fun of another faith's holy book
   B. Keeping it clean
   C. Listening carefully
   D. Reading with respect

16. Who wrote the Ramayan in Sanskrit? (1 mark)
   A. Sage Valmiki
   B. Sigala
   C. Guru Nanak
   D. Guru Arjan Dev

17. Who gave the Sigalovada Sutta talk? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Arjan Dev
   B. Mahavir
   C. Valmiki
   D. The Buddha

18. Who went into the forest with Ram? (1 mark)
   A. Sita and Lakshman
   B. Kaikeyi
   C. Vishwamitra
   D. Bharat and Shatrughna

19. From which Veda does the Gayatri Mantra come? (1 mark)
   A. Ramayan
   B. Atharva Veda only
   C. Rig Veda
   D. Dhammapada

20. Which words begin the well-known Saraswati Vandana? (1 mark)
   A. Om Namah Shivaya
   B. Twameva mata cha pita twameva
   C. Ya Kundendu Tushara Hara Dhavala
   D. Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah

21. What is the shikhara? (1 mark)
   A. The floor
   B. The spire above the inner room
   C. The bell
   D. The kitchen

22. Which is fair play in a game? (1 mark)
   A. Pushing
   B. Tripping others
   C. Cheating
   D. Following the rules even when nobody is looking

23. Which is a sign of integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in a test
   B. Taking a friend's pen
   C. Keeping your promises
   D. Telling lies

24. Which king is known for always telling the truth in a Hindu story? (1 mark)
   A. Ravan
   B. Hiranyakashipu
   C. Harishchandra
   D. Kansa

25. When should you practise yoga? (1 mark)
   A. While eating
   B. While running
   C. Right after a big meal
   D. When your stomach is not full

26. In Bhastrika, how is the breath done? (1 mark)
   A. Not at all
   B. Only in
   C. In and out with equal strength
   D. Only out

27. What is the correct way to sit for Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Standing on one leg
   B. Slouching
   C. With a straight back and relaxed body
   D. Lying on the stomach

28. Why do children work in pairs in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. To race
   B. To check posture and encourage each other
   C. To copy
   D. To argue

29. How many Purusharthas are there? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Two
   C. Ten
   D. Four

30. Which principle is being followed by greeting parents with Namaste and saying a morning prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Artha only
   B. Kama only
   C. Prarthana and respect for Paramatma
   D. Punarjanam only

31. Which king protected a dove in a well-known story? (1 mark)
   A. King Shibi
   B. Harishchandra
   C. Ravan
   D. Hiranyakashipu

32. Which of the five principles is about goals? (1 mark)
   A. Prarthana
   B. Punarjanam
   C. Purushartha
   D. Paramatma

33. What does Maha Shivratri teach? (1 mark)
   A. Winning arguments
   B. Self-control, faith and staying alert to do good
   C. Getting rich
   D. Playing games all night

34. Which practice is part of Paryushan? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting
   B. Hunting
   C. Cheating
   D. Shouting

35. How should you behave when visiting a friend's festival? (1 mark)
   A. Refuse to take part
   B. Listen and ask polite questions
   C. Laugh at customs
   D. Shout

36. Which stories are told about Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. That it is the birth of the Buddha
   B. That it is a harvest festival of Kenya
   C. That it is the night of Shiva and Parvati's wedding or of Shiva's great dance
   D. That it is a Jain festival of forgiveness

37. How long is Paryushan in one Jain tradition? (1 mark)
   A. Two days
   B. Eight days
   C. One year
   D. One month

38. What is the Indian name for Sunday? (1 mark)
   A. Somvaar
   B. Shanivaar
   C. Mangalvaar
   D. Ravivaar

39. The Indian traditional calendar is based on what? (1 mark)
   A. Only the rain
   B. The school year
   C. Only the stars of the south
   D. The Moon and the Sun

40. What is the Sun in modern science? (1 mark)
   A. A star
   B. A moon
   C. A comet
   D. A planet

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Describe the lessons of the Uttaradhyayan Sutra. (4 marks)

42. Name the two Buddhist scriptures in this lesson. (2 marks)

43. Explain why balance is important in the four Purusharthas. (5 marks)

44. List three ideal practices of a passenger while travelling. (3 marks)

45. Name two things a lost and found corner needs. (2 marks)

46. Write three main teachings of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. (3 marks)

47. Give two signs of integrity. (2 marks)

48. Describe how to pray well. (4 marks)

49. Name the four Enlightened Beings studied in this lesson. (2 marks)

50. Explain why respect for a Mandir is important and how a visitor of any faith can show it. (5 marks)

51. Match the days to the planets: Budhvaar, Guruvaar, Shukravaar. (3 marks)

52. What does the word Panch Mahabhoot mean? (2 marks)

53. Compare the three festivals: Maha Shivratri, Paryushan Parva and Madaraka Day. (5 marks)

54. Write the Indian names for Sunday and Monday. (2 marks)

55. Explain what Hindus mean by an Avtar. (2 marks)

56. Who compiled Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji first, and who declared it the eternal Guru? (2 marks)

57. What is a festival? (2 marks)

58. Describe what the Panchang is. (2 marks)

59. Explain the Jain teaching called Asteya. (2 marks)

60. What does Dainik Prarthana mean? (2 marks)

61. Give the meaning of Maha Shivratri. (2 marks)

62. Name two parts of a Mandir. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — They give oxygen and shade
   Plants clean the air and give shade.

2. B — Air
   Vayu means air and wind.

3. D — Ganga
   In the stories Ganga is honoured as a goddess.

4. B — In a pot or raised stand in the courtyard
   The stand is called the Tulsi Vrindavan.

5. C — Listen carefully and behave politely
   We show respect to all faiths.

6. B — The Buddha, the Awakened One
   Siddhartha became the Buddha.

7. B — In the evening, between day and night
   It was neither day nor night but the time between.

8. B — A teacher who leads from darkness to light
   A guru is a teacher and guide.

9. B — A pillar in the palace
   The pillar broke open and he appeared.

10. C — He pulled out the arrow and nursed it
   He helped the hurt bird.

11. C — King Suddhodana
   Siddhartha's father was King Suddhodana.

12. B — A book of wise sayings and verses
   It teaches how to live wisely.

13. C — A young man taught by the Buddha
   The talk was given to him.

14. C — There is one God
   Ik Onkar means One God.

15. A — Making fun of another faith's holy book
   We should respect all scriptures.

16. A — Sage Valmiki
   Valmiki is honoured as its author.

17. D — The Buddha
   The Buddha spoke to a young man named Sigala.

18. A — Sita and Lakshman
   Sita and Lakshman chose to go with him.

19. C — Rig Veda
   The Gayatri Mantra comes from the Rig Veda.

20. C — Ya Kundendu Tushara Hara Dhavala
   This is the opening line.

21. B — The spire above the inner room
   It is the spire or dome.

22. D — Following the rules even when nobody is looking
   Fair play is integrity.

23. C — Keeping your promises
   Keeping promises shows honesty.

24. C — Harishchandra
   Harishchandra kept his word.

25. D — When your stomach is not full
   Do it with an empty stomach.

26. C — In and out with equal strength
   Breathing is equal, like a bellows.

27. C — With a straight back and relaxed body
   A straight back helps breathing.

28. B — To check posture and encourage each other
   Pairs encourage and help.

29. D — Four
   There are four.

30. C — Prarthana and respect for Paramatma
   Prayer and respect for God.

31. A — King Shibi
   King Shibi saved the dove.

32. C — Purushartha
   Goals of life.

33. B — Self-control, faith and staying alert to do good
   These are its lessons.

34. A — Fasting
   Fasting, prayer and charity.

35. B — Listen and ask polite questions
   Respect is key.

36. C — That it is the night of Shiva and Parvati's wedding or of Shiva's great dance
   Different stories are told.

37. B — Eight days
   Eight days in one tradition and ten in another.

38. D — Ravivaar
   Ravi is the Sun.

39. D — The Moon and the Sun
   It is lunar and solar.

40. A — A star
   The Sun is a star.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: Practise Ahimsa, be honest, control greed and anger, and respect teachers (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Dhammapada and the Sigalovada Sutta.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

43. (5 marks)
   Answer: Wealth and wishes are good but must follow Dharma. Without balance, chasing money or wishes can lead to cheating and harm, while Dharma keeps us honest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for balance, 2 marks for Dharma guiding the others, 2 marks for an example.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wear the seat belt, sit still, keep hands and head inside, keep the aisle clear, do not litter, do not distract the driver, give up your seat (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: A box or table for found items and a book to record the date and finder (any two sensible items).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: There is one God, all human beings are equal, earn honestly and share with others, and serve without expecting a reward (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each teaching.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Telling the truth, keeping promises, returning what is not yours, not cheating (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: Sit quietly, fold hands, think of God with love, say thanks, ask for wisdom and kindness, and end with a promise to do good (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Narsimha, Parshvanath, Buddha (Prince Siddhartha) and Sri Guru Ram Das Ji.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each name.

50. (5 marks)
   Answer: A Mandir is a holy place. Visitors can remove shoes, dress modestly, speak softly, ask before photos and accept prasad politely. Respect brings peace among faiths.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for holy place, 3 marks for three ways, 1 mark for peace.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mercury, Jupiter, Venus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Five great elements.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for five and 1 mark for great elements.

53. (5 marks)
   Answer: Maha Shivratri is Hindu, a night of prayer for Shiva. Paryushan is Jain, of fasting and forgiveness. Madaraka Day is national, about self-government and patriotism. All bring people together.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for correct faith or type, 2 marks for themes, 1 mark for a similarity.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: Sunday: Ravivaar. Monday: Somvaar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: A form in which God is believed to come to earth to protect goodness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God coming to earth and 1 mark for protecting goodness.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guru Arjan Dev Ji compiled it; Guru Gobind Singh Ji declared it the Guru.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each name.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: A special day or set of days when people come together to remember something important.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for special day and 1 mark for remembering or celebrating together.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Indian traditional calendar book that lists days, months and festival dates.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for two points.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: Not taking what is not given, or not stealing.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for a correct meaning.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: Daily prayers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for daily and 1 mark for prayers.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: The great night of Lord Shiva.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for great night and 1 mark for Shiva.

62. (2 marks)
   Answer: Entrance, main hall, inner room (garbhagriha), spire (shikhara), bell (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
